name: New Smyrna Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in New Smyrna Beach?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, plain golf carts no on city streets. In New Smyrna Beach, LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less but not A1A/Atlantic Avenue or 3rd Avenue, which they may cross at intersections.

rules.rule: Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections
No LSVs on A1A/Atlantic Ave or 3rd Ave; cross at intersections

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in New Smyrna Beach?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Not A1A/Atlantic Ave or 3rd Ave. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on 3rd Avenue in New Smyrna Beach?
faq.a: No. Police say LSVs may only cross 3rd Avenue.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in New Smyrna Beach?
faq.a: Not on city streets; the city hasn't designated any for golf carts.
